meta.name: MWZ BNB mainnet V2: UP votes into the capped protocol vault
meta.description: UPVoteTreasury 0xF6AA6eD3 currently forwards every $3 UP vote to the Safe; point feeReceiver at ProtocolRevenueVault 0xc2d4E6f8 so UP-vote revenue enters the capped vault like every other protocol fee. Owner-only setter, no upgrade. Import in Safe Transaction Builder on BNB (Safe 0x1edcEdf5).
